title: H-CARSTACK-1 LOG-ONLY probe - cars around a consensus TIME SKIP. Both players stand outdoors together on the save1 street (about 11 m apart, host traffic around them, client in ghost mode); a 3-game-hour consensus skip, then 25 s. The probe passes every 2 s on BOTH machines while the skip runs and for 20 s after it ends, logging the traffic mode, the Gley cars alive (ambient / service / routed), the ghosts present, the worst frame since the previous pass, and any overlapping PAIR. Asserts only the premise: the skip started (consensus) and ended (goal reached), and each machine logged at least 3 skip passes. Every PAIR line is reported, not judged. NO save.
preconditions: Fixture save1 (host melaus, Client1; both spawn outdoors about 11 m apart). Dev build with the skipvote / skipstate / pause levers (BAMP_DEV).
